We need to process this information to fulfill our contract with You and, if You are a user located in the EEA, our legal basis for the processing of this Personal Information is Art. 6 (1) lit. b) of the GDPR. In addition, We process this data when you decide to submit the Content to Us and because of these purposes represent our legitimate interests. Therefore, if You are a user located in the EEA, our legal basis for the processing of this Personal Information is also Art. 6 (1) lit. a) of the GDPR, and Art. 6 (1) lit. f) of the GDPR. We need to process this information to fulfill our contract with You and if you are a user located in the EEA, our legal basis for the processing of this Personal Information is Art. 6 (1) lit. a) of the GDPR. Except as stated otherwise in this Policy, Tymely may stores Your Personal Information while You are using the Services, but is not required to do so and simply access to such information will be required to provide you with the Services. Tymely may also store Personal Information, including Personal Information which may be included in the Content, for a period of time after You are no longer using the Site or after you have terminated the use of the Services, as this Personal Information might be required for various purposes even where Your contractual relationship with Us has ended. These purposes typically include business or legal reasons such as statutory retention periods or our defense against legal claims. You may ask to delete such information just by letting Us know Your wish using the Contact Info detailed below. Notwithstanding any of the above, Tymely is not required to store your information in order to provide you with the Services and in most cases simply access to such information will be required to provide you with the Services. In case you wish Tymely to remove the information please contact us as detailed below. All information provided by You or collected by Tymely is stored on our secured servers. Unfortunately, the transmission of information via the internet is not completely secure. As Dailylook grew, maintaining personal attention to each client became increasingly difficult. Response times were stretching into the next day, and scaling by hiring more agents wasn’t sustainable. The Challenge Customer service plays a central role in Dailylook’s retention strategy. Every interaction has the potential to build or break customer loyalty. But as their subscriber base expanded, ticket volume soared, and the team faced increasing pressure to respond faster while maintaining high quality. They explored multiple AI solutions, from big platforms to startups, but none could handle the complex, nuanced requests that Dailylook’s stylists received daily. Most tools still escalated tricky cases to human agents, slowing down service and driving up costs. The Solution That changed with Tymely. Tymely mapped Dailylook’s thousands of unique flows and undocumented edge cases, learning directly from real agent interactions to replicate their voice, tone, and decision-making. The onboarding was fast and low-effort, integrating seamlessly with Dailylook’s existing systems - even the homegrown ones. The Results With Tymely, Dailylook delivers the same premium, human-level experience but faster, more consistently, and more affordably than ever before. Today, Dailylook’s customer service team can focus on what matters most, building relationships and loyalty, while Tymely handles the rest with the same level of quality and care the brand is known for.
